working_definition: Epithelial cluster of the adult ejaculatory bulb; authors gave no FBbt id ('Manual Annotation').

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell of the epithelium of the ejaculatory bulb. It secretes the male pheromone cis-vaccenyl acetate (cVA) (Guiraudie-Capraz et al., 2007).

justification: FBbt:00058268 'ejaculatory bulb epithelium' is a tissue (label match); the cluster is composed of cells, so the cell-level term, ejaculatory bulb epithelial cell, is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A monolayer epithelium forming the wall of the ejaculatory bulb (Guiraudie-Capraz et al., 2007).
